payload.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-05-31
payload.summary:
English: Today’s snapshot covers **Claude Managed Agents** adding dreaming, outcomes, orchestration, and webhooks; **Gemini** co-lead Oriol Vinyals on world models, multimodal learning, RL, memory, and robotics; plus builder posts on **Codex**, **GPT-5.5**, **Vercel AI Gateway**, **Cursor** auto-review, AI education, enterprise AI investment, and California politics.

中文：今天的快照包括 **Claude Managed Agents** 新增 dreaming、outcomes、多智能体编排和 webhooks；**Gemini** 联合负责人 Oriol Vinyals 谈世界模型、多模态学习、RL、记忆和机器人；以及关于 **Codex**、**GPT-5.5**、**Vercel AI Gateway**、**Cursor** auto-review、AI 教育、企业 AI 投入和加州政治的 builder 动态。

sections.headline: **Gemini** co-lead on world models, memory, RL, and robotics · **Gemini** 联合负责人谈世界模型、记忆、RL 和机器人
sections.body:
The episode features Oriol Vinyals, co-lead of **Gemini**, discussing the research behind recent **Google I/O** launches. The conversation centers on world models, multimodal training, video and image understanding, memory, scaffolding, reinforcement learning, and how simulation could connect to robotics and self-driving use cases.

这期节目请到 **Gemini** 联合负责人 Oriol Vinyals，聊 **Google I/O** 后一系列发布背后的研究脉络。重点包括世界模型、多模态训练、视频和图像理解、记忆、脚手架、强化学习，以及模拟能力如何连接到机器人和自动驾驶场景。

sections.headline: **Claude Managed Agents** adds dreaming, outcomes, orchestration, and webhooks · **Claude Managed Agents** 新增 dreaming、outcomes、编排和 webhooks
sections.body:
**Claude Managed Agents** is adding dreaming as a research preview, along with outcomes, multiagent orchestration, and webhooks. Dreaming reviews past sessions and memory stores to extract patterns, curate memory, and help agents improve over time. Outcomes lets developers define success rubrics that a separate grader checks against, while multiagent orchestration lets a lead agent delegate work to specialist agents running in parallel.

**Claude Managed Agents** 新增了 research preview 版 dreaming，同时开放 outcomes、多智能体编排和 webhooks。Dreaming 会回看过往会话和记忆库，提炼模式、整理记忆，让 agent 随时间变得更好。Outcomes 让开发者定义成功标准，由独立 grader 检查结果；多智能体编排则让主 agent 把任务拆给并行工作的专家 agent。

sections.headline: Enterprise AI savings may be reinvested into growth · 企业 AI 省下的钱可能会重新投向增长
sections.body:
Again, maybe counterintuitive, but in the majority of conversations I have with CIOs, CTOs, and CEOs in large enterprises, they are either growing due to AI (in new job functions like FDEs, engineering, etc.) or at a minimum reinvesting efficiency savings back into the business in new areas (sales, marketing, etc.).

David Solomon, CEO of Goldman Sachs, articulated this perfectly in a NYTimes OpEd last week. The AI boom is both creating all new jobs in the build out of AI systems and the implementation across sectors, but also freeing up dollars to invest in areas that have been underfunded or have more demand now because of AI. 

Most businesses have been constrained by how much software they can produce at a given cost, how many sales reps they can hire, how many marketing campaigns they can run, how they can do outbound customer success motions with enough tailoring, how they can find more risk in their business and prevent it, and 100s of other things. 

When AI makes it possible to do more of this, investment goes back into the business. The companies that better serve their customers win over the long run, and those that just try and find savings end up doing worse.

再说一次，这可能有点反直觉，但我和大型企业里的 CIO、CTO、CEO 聊下来，大多数公司要么因为 AI 在增长，比如新增 FDE、工程等岗位；要么至少会把效率提升省下来的钱重新投到业务的新领域里，比如销售、营销等。

**Goldman Sachs** CEO David Solomon 上周在 **NYTimes** 的 OpEd 里讲得很准确。AI 热潮一方面在 AI 系统建设和跨行业落地过程中创造全新的岗位，另一方面也释放出资金，让企业投向过去投入不足、或因为 AI 出现更多需求的领域。

大多数企业一直受限于很多事：在固定成本下能生产多少软件，能招多少销售，能跑多少营销活动，能不能做足够定制化的 outbound customer success，能不能发现并阻止更多业务风险，以及其他上百件事。

当 AI 让企业能做更多这类事时，投资会回到业务里。长期看，更好服务客户的公司会赢；只想着省钱的公司会做得更差。

sections.headline: Urban nuclear families make raising multiple children hard · 城市核心家庭让多孩养育变得很难
sections.body:
Most people I talk to in India have 1 child. Some have 2.

When I tell them I have three, their first reaction is total surprise followed by "well, accidents happen".

The main reason for one? Raising kids is just really hard, especially for nuclear families in cities.

我在印度聊到的大多数人都有 1 个孩子，有些有 2 个。

当我告诉他们我有 3 个时，他们的第一反应是非常惊讶，接着就是“嗯，意外总会发生”。

为什么大多只要一个？养孩子真的很难，尤其是城市里的核心家庭。
